paragraphs.text: Flashback is a keyword ability on instants and sorceries that allows the player to pay an alternative cost to cast the spell from their graveyard . The spell card is exiled when the spell leaves the stack . It was introduced in Odyssey .

The first tournament-legal cards with flashback were printed in Odyssey block , where a small headstone was marked next to the name, as an aid for remembering flashback spells in the graveyard. This was not repeated after that block. Non-mana flashback costs were printed in Torment , followed by off-color and unique other costs in Judgment . The mechanic returned in the Time Spiral and Innistrad block s, alongside minor presences in Modern Horizons , Commander 2019 and Modern Horizons 2 .

During major return in Innistrad: Midnight Hunt , the first multicolor flashback cards were printed. Starting with Phyrexia: All Will Be One , R&D have made Flashback a deciduous mechanic. Since then, Final Fantasy , Magic: The Gathering Foundations and Secrets of Strixhaven have had Flashback as a major mechanic, where in the latter it was one of the main mechanics associated with the Lorehold college.

In Dark Ascension there were a cycle of spells that had a greater effect when cast from the graveyard, which is a clause that appears on future cards often and especially in Final Fantasy . Otterball Antics has a unique clause of "anywhere other than the hand", encapsulating various cast-from-exile methods, something that returned on Antiquities on the Loose .

In Final Fantasy most cards with Flashback represented plot flashbacks from the series. This began as suggestion from Yoni Skolnik to better tie the mechanic, initially chosen for its mechanical value as a mana sink, to the source material. The concept would make a minor appearance in Avatar: The Last Airbender ( Solstice Revelations , Lost in Memories ). Head designer Mark Rosewater believes Flashback being used this way again is a matter of "When", rather than "if".
Ray of Revelation Instant Destroy target enchantment. Flashback (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)
